Thanks for following @BelowNatural on twitter!|Former Inventory Description}} |-|Version 1 = {{QuoteBox|Thanks for following @BelowNatural on twitter!|Former Inventory Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Hunter''' is an intermediate tower that can be purchased from the store for {{Coins|1,000}}. It could have also been obtained from a now expired [[Codes|code]]. The '''Hunter''' has a decently long range and deals a high amount of damage, however has a rather slow firerate. Uniquely, it requires time to aim before it can start attacking. It can attack [[Flying]] enemies at Level 0, and gains hidden detection at Level 3, In [[PVP]] mode, the hidden detection is unlocked at Level 1 instead. Therefore, the '''Hunter''' is a fairly good mid-late game DPS tower, being a good and simpler [[Ranger]] alternative for newer players. The '''Hunter''' deals high damage at later levels, making it a consistently good tower across all modes, even [[Frost Mode|Frost]] and [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] modes. The '''Hunter''' excels at mid-late game DPS, especially good against slow, tanky enemies because of the slow reload and high damage bullet. When concentrated on one spot, multiple '''Hunters''' can take down bosses with ease and aid other DPS anchors in taking down later bosses. The '''Hunter''' has a placement limit of ten per player. ==Upgrades== {{PVPTabber |{{Upgrade|Level = Level 1|Upgrade Title = Quickscope|Cost = {{Money|725}}|Image = [[File:Hunter This makes it much easier for multiple hunters to receive buffs from other support towers such as [[DJ Booth]] or [[Ace Pilot]]. *The '''Hunter''' is an excellent DPS tower, but it is still advised to bring at least one other DPS tower, especially in much tougher gamemodes such as [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]], where tanky enemies appear often and overwhelm '''Hunters''' easily. ==Trivia== *The original name for the '''Hunter''' was going to be called ''Clout God'' and it had a [https://twitter.com/BelowNatural/status/1164008525061939206 different design]. **The name and design were changed as some people felt it was too similar to the [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Tweeter|Tweeter]] from ''Tower Battles''. **The first version of the {{Color|Basic|Blue}} skin for the '''Hunter''' looks similar to the original design. *The '''Hunter''' is the first tower that is not a cliff or air-based tower which can detect flying enemies. *Prior the [[v1.84.0]] update, the '''Hunter''' was a starter tower. ==Update History== ''For previous cosmetic variations, see the [[/Gallery|gallery]] page.'' {{Scroll|text= *'''13 October 2019''' -
